arxiv-1910-12086.title: A holistic approach to polyphonic music transcription with neural networks
arxiv-1910-12086.description: Abstract We present a framework based on neural networks to extract music scores directly from polyphonic audio in an end-to-end fashion. Most previous Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) methods seek a piano-roll representation of the pitches, that can be further transformed into a score by incorporating tempo estimation, beat tracking, key estimation or rhythm quantization.

arxiv-2111-05217.title: The Thermal Conductance of Sapphire Ball Based Detector Clamps Journal: Journal of Low Temperature Physics
arxiv-2111-05217.creator: H.D. Pinckney, G. Yacteen, A. Serafin, S.A. Hertel, For the Ricochet Collaboration
arxiv-2111-05217.description: Abstract In order to provide secure clamping with a low thermal conductance, some low temperature detectors are held with point contact sapphire ball clamps. While this method is increasingly common, the thermal conductance across this interface has not been well studied.

arxiv-2112-10119.title: Explicit multivariate approximations from cell-average data
arxiv-2112-10119.creator: Sergio Amat, David Levin, Juan Ruiz, Dionisio F. Yáñez
arxiv-2112-10119.description: Abstract Given gridded cell-average data of a smooth multivariate function, we present a constructive explicit procedure for generating a high-order global approximation of the function. One contribution is the derivation of high order approximations to point-values of the function directly from the cell-average data.

arxiv-2204-03283.title: Optimal convergence order for multi-scale stochastic Burgers equation
arxiv-2204-03283.creator: Peng Gao, Xiaobin Sun
arxiv-2204-03283.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the strong and weak convergence rates for multi-scale one-dimensional stochastic Burgers equation. Based on the techniques of Galerkin approximation, Kolmogorov equation and Poisson equation, we obtain the slow component strongly and weakly converges to the solution of the corresponding averaged equation with optimal orders 1/2 and 1 respectively.

arxiv-2208-13651.title: A Metric Lower Bound Estimate for Geodesics in the Space of Kähler Potentials
arxiv-2208-13651.creator: Jingchen Hu
arxiv-2208-13651.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jingchen Hu. In this paper we establish a positive lower bound estimate for the second smallest eigenvalue of the complex Hessian of solutions to a degenerate complex Monge-Ampère equation. As a consequence, we find that in the space of Kähler potentials any two points close to each other in C 2 C^{2} norm can be connected by a geodesic along which the associated metrics do not degenerate.

arxiv-2301-05551.title: Dynamic Basis Function Interpolation for Adaptive In Situ Data Integration in Ocean Modeling
arxiv-2301-05551.creator: Derek DeSantis, Phillip J. Wolfram, Ayan Biswas, Earl Lawrence
arxiv-2301-05551.description: Abstract We propose a new method for combining in situ buoy measurements with Earth system models (ESMs) to improve the accuracy of temperature predictions in the ocean. The technique utilizes the dynamics and modes identified in ESMs alongside buoy measurements to improve accuracy while preserving features such as seasonality.

arxiv-2303-02938.title: RIS-aided Wireless Communications: Can RIS Beat Metal Plate?
arxiv-2303-02938.creator: Jiangfeng Hu, Haifan Yin, Li Tan, Lin Cao, Xilong Pei
arxiv-2303-02938.description: Abstract Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) has recently been regarded as a paradigm-shifting technology beyond 5G, for its flexibility on smartly adjusting the response to the impinging electromagnetic (EM) waves. Usually, RIS can be implemented by properly reconfiguring the adjustable parameters of each RIS unit to align the signal phase on the receiver side.

arxiv-2306-12545.title: Neural Multigrid Memory For Computational Fluid Dynamics
arxiv-2306-12545.creator: Duc Minh Nguyen, Minh Chau Vu, Tuan Anh Nguyen, Tri Huynh, Nguyen Tri Nguyen, Truong Son Hy
arxiv-2306-12545.description: Abstract Turbulent flow simulation plays a crucial role in various applications, including aircraft and ship design, industrial process optimization, and weather prediction. In this paper, we propose an advanced data-driven method for simulating turbulent flow, representing a significant improvement over existing approaches.

arxiv-2311-16699.title: An extended discontinuous Galerkin shock tracking method
arxiv-2311-16699.creator: Jakob Vandergrift, Florian Kummer
arxiv-2311-16699.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a novel high-order shock tracking method and provide a proof of concept. Our method leverages concepts from implicit shock tracking and extended discontinuous Galerkin methods, primarily designed for solving partial differential equations featuring discontinuities.

arxiv-2410-04900.title: Two-electron atomic systems. A simple method for calculating the ground state near the nucleus. Some applications.
arxiv-2410-04900.creator: Evgeny Z. Liverts
arxiv-2410-04900.description: Abstract A simple method of variational calculations of the electronic structure of a two-electron atom/ion, primarily near the nucleus, is proposed. The method as a whole consists of a standard solution of a generalized matrix eigenvalue equation, all matrix elements of which are reduced to a numerical calculation of one-dimensional integrals.

arxiv-2507-22228.title: Steinberg-Guinan strength model for rhenium
arxiv-2507-22228.creator: Damian C. Swift
arxiv-2507-22228.description: Abstract Rhenium, Re, is used as an x-ray shield in laser-driven material property experiments, where its strength at high pressures can be a consideration in the design, modeling, and interpretation. We present a Steinberg-Guinan (SG) strength model for Re, tailored for use in high-pressure dynamic loading simulations.

arxiv-2604-24284.creator: Kota Otsuka, Kazuki Yokomizo

pmc-10647328.title: Monoterpenoid Glycosides from the Leaves of Ligustrum robustum and Their Bioactivities (II)
pmc-10647328.creator: Shi-Hui Lu, Xiu-Xia Li, Hao-Jiang Zuo, Wei-Neng Li, Jia-Ping Pan, Jing Huang
pmc-10647328.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Ligustrum robustum has been not only used as a heat-clearing and detoxicating functional tea (Ku-Ding-Cha) but also consumed as a hypotensive, anti-diabetic, and weight-reducing folk medicine. pmc-10713663.title: Protein and lipid expansion microscopy with trypsin and tyramide signal amplification for 3D imaging
pmc-10713663.creator: Ueh-Ting Tim Wang, Xuejiao Tian, Yae-Huei Liou, Sue-Ping Lee, Hsiao-Tang Hu, Chieh-Han Lu, Po-Ting Lin, Ya-Jen Cheng, Peilin Chen, Bi-Chang Chen
pmc-10713663.description: Expansion microscopy, whereby the relative positions of biomolecules are physically increased via hydrogel expansion, can be used to reveal ultrafine structures of cells under a conventional microscope. Despite its utility for achieving super-resolution imaging, expansion microscopy suffers a major drawback, namely reduced fluorescence signals caused by excessive proteolysis and swelling effects.

pmc-12475941.title: Incidence, Diagnoses, and Outcomes of Pediatric Nontraumatic Chest Pain Attended by Ambulance
pmc-12475941.creator: Daniel Okyere, Emily Nehme, Emily Mahony, Dion Stub, Luke P. Dawson, Jocasta Ball, Ben Meadley, David Anderson, Tegwyn McManamny, Ziad Nehme
pmc-12475941.description: This cohort study analyzes the incidence, diagnoses, and outcomes of children in Australia attended by emergency medical services for nontraumatic chest pain. Introduction Nontraumatic chest pain is a common problem,1,2 but less is known about it in children and adolescents seeking emergency medical services (EMS) care.

pmc-12687692.title: Integrating Cardiovascular Prevention Into Psoriasis Care Using Text Messaging: Insights From the TEXTME PSO Trial
pmc-12687692.creator: Annika Smith, Dominique Hespe, Clara K. Chow
pmc-12687692.description: ng (TM) have proven effective in chronic disease management, but their role in psoriasis remains underexplored. User feedback is critical to ensure acceptability, engagement and impact. While guidelines now recommend routine CVD risk assessment in this population [2], uptake in clinical practice remains inconsistent [3], compounded by variable clinician awareness of the psoriasis–CVD link [3].

pmc-12729361.title: Embedding Trauma-Informed Strategies Within a Multitiered System of Supports: A Framework for Early Childhood Education
pmc-12729361.creator: Freddie Pastrana Rivera, Zachary C. LaBrot, Brittany Garza, Josselyn Telule, Lourdes Rodriguez, Abigail Ann Wilkinson
pmc-12729361.description: Program-wide Positive Behavior Supports (PW-PBIS) is a data-driven multitiered model of service delivery in which young children receive increasingly intensive supports to address their social–emotional and behavioral needs. PW-PBIS implementation in early childhood education has consistently been found effective for preventing a variety of undesirable outcomes while also promoting young children’s social–emotional and behavioral functioning.

pmc-12785279.title: Acute Kidney Injury Biomarkers in Perioperative Care: A Scoping Review of Clinical Implementation
pmc-12785279.creator: Konrad Zuzda, Paulina Walczak-Wieteska, Paweł Andruszkiewicz, Jolanta Małyszko
pmc-12785279.description: Background: Acute kidney injury (AKI) remains one of the most common perioperative complications, carrying substantial mortality and healthcare burden. Traditional diagnostic criteria relying on serum creatinine and urine output are limited by delayed detection and inability to characterize the underlying injury phenotype.

pmc-12962869.title: The Promise of Integration of HIV Into Primary Care: Challenges and Opportunities
pmc-12962869.creator: Wafaa M El‐Sadr, Joey Platt
pmc-12962869.description: IntroductionRemarkable progress has been made in response to the global HIV epidemic, yet critical gaps and inequities remain, combined with challenges stemming from the current threats to global funding, complacency and competing global health priorities. These constraints threaten to unravel the hard‐won gains and to stall progress towards control of the HIV epidemic.

pmc-13221712.title: Resilience to HPV vaccine safety scares in seven countries
pmc-13221712.creator: Mallory K Ellingson, Milkie Vu, Dur-E-Nayab Waheed, Swati Saxena, Fernando Pio de la Hoz, Natalia Pasternak, Yvonne Morrissey, Sharon Hanley, Michelle Fiscus, Tsetsegsaikhan Batmunkh, Paulo Almeida, Noel T Brewer
pmc-13221712.description: BackgroundResilience is the ability of a vaccination programme to return to high coverage after a disrupting event, such as a safety scare that undermines vaccine provision. To identify insights that can help countries achieve resilience in their vaccination programmes, we reviewed the experiences of countries that faced HPV vaccine safety scares.

pmc-13263620.title: Time Course and Determinants of Acute Dysgeusia in Patients Receiving Head and Neck Radiation Therapy
pmc-13263620.creator: Sreenija Yarlagadda, Arun Maharaj, Tiffany Nong, Andrea V Gonzalez, Naima-Sajoni C Guerra, Dylan M Paterniti-Ruscin, Elysse Castro-Hall, Nicolas Carvallo, Lorein Gonzalez, Muni Rubens, Adeel Kaiser, Noah S Kalman
pmc-13263620.description: PurposeDysgeusia is a common toxicity experienced by patients with head and neck cancer (HNC) receiving radiation therapy (RT). In this study, we assessed the timescale of onset, progression, and recovery of dysgeusia using an objective measure.Methods and MaterialsPatients receiving RT for HNC to ≥ 50 Gy were included in this prospective observational study.

pmc-13360125.title: Anisotropic Memristive Switching in NbOCl2 Enabled by Directional Oxygen Ion Migration
pmc-13360125.creator: Caokun Wang, Yun Ji, Sanchali Mitra, Yufei Shi, Haofei Zheng, Yee Sin Ang, Kah‐Wee Ang
pmc-13360125.description: Directional ion transport in anisotropic two‐dimensional (2D) materials provides a powerful yet underexplored pathway for engineering memristive functionalities. Here, we demonstrate strongly orientation‐dependent memristive switching in layered NbOCl2 lateral devices, where resistive switching occurs exclusively along the in‐plane c‐axis, while devices aligned along the b‐axis exhibit no hysteresis.

pmc-13495573.title: Deployment of a herd health package increases production traits and reduces parasite load and disease incidence in sheep and goats in Mali
pmc-13495573.creator: Olivier Mahuton Zannou, Cheick Amadou Tidiani Diakité, Chaka Traoré, Ahmadou Sow, Ons Tebourbi, Mourad Rekik, Michel Dione
pmc-13495573.description: Small ruminant production plays a crucial role in rural livelihoods and food security in Mali but is constrained by infectious diseases, parasitic infections, poor nutrition, and limited preventive healthcare. This study evaluated the effect of implementing a herd health package on the productivity, parasite load, and disease incidence in small ruminant herds in the Farakala commune, Sikasso region, Mali.

pmc-13509975.title: The Potential of Alamandine in Airway Hyperresponsiveness in an Ovalbumin-Induced Asthma Model
pmc-13509975.creator: Vitória Nedel Rech, Andresa Thomé Silveira, Giuliano Rizzotto Guimarães, Katya Rigatto
pmc-13509975.description: Background: Asthma is a chronic inflammatory airway disease characterized by variable airflow obstruction and tissue remodeling. Alamandine (ALA), a renin–angiotensin system (RAS) peptide with anti-inflammatory properties, remains poorly explored in allergic respiratory disease. Objectives: This study evaluated prophylactic (33 days) and therapeutic (21 days) subcutaneous ALA (50 µg/kg/day) administration in an ovalbumin (OVA)-induced rat asthma model.
